title: Surreal Surgeon in Ruined Theater
description: A man dressed as a surgeon with a dotted surgical mask and head covering stands in a dilapidated circular theater under a starry sky with green aurora borealis. His left arm is splayed open with playing cards, surgical tools, and blood, while he holds a scalpel in his right hand and raises his other gloved hand; a table with green cloth holds a top hat, scroll, pocket watch, and scattered papers.
prompt: A surreal scene of a surgeon wearing a dotted face mask and surgical cap standing inside a ruined circular theater with peeling walls and empty seats, green aurora borealis glowing in the night sky above, the surgeon's left forearm is surgically opened revealing embedded playing cards and medical instruments with blood dripping, he holds a scalpel in one hand while raising the other gloved hand, on a table covered with green cloth in front of him sits a top hat, unrolled scroll, pocket watch, and red wax seal, dramatic lighting, highly detailed painting
